description: 충청북도 진천군_주유소 현황 [fuel stations and oil] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청북도 진천군. 본 데이터는 충청북도 진천군 관내 석유판매업 중 주유소업에 해당하는 영업소들의 현황을 정리한 자료로, 각 주유소의 상호명, 소재지, 기준일 등을 포함하고 있습니다. 현재 운영 중인 60개 주유소에 대한 정보를 제공함으로써 지역 내 연료공급 인프라 현황을 파악할 수 있으며, 소비자 접근성 분석, 에너지 기... Coverage: 충청북도 진천군. The portal files it under the publisher 충청북도 진천군. Its tags are 석유판매업, 주유소, 지역상권, 에너지시설, 충전소현황. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
